statement: The proof nonce is its own counter (a frame's slot); gaps appear only after a refused attempt (R-RETRY-NEW-NONCE, the retry signs at a fresh slot) and between the two sides' lanes (Left's first slot is the last committed one + 2, Right's + 1, Q-A-14); signatures are one per (signer, nonce, author side). The Arrival cell holds this on spec/account/frames.scm through the slot lane (bugs retry-reuses-the-nonce, slots-shared-lane).
